name: Vonage AI Studio
positioning: A low-code conversational flow builder from Vonage for virtual agents across voice, SMS, WhatsApp and web chat, billed on top of Vonage API usage.

pricing.model: Plan fee (Standard $0, Advanced $1,100/month, Fully Managed custom) plus per-request AI charges and regular Vonage API charges
pricing.headline: Standard plan $0/month; Advanced $1,100/month; voice minutes are billed separately at regular Vonage API rates, so no all-in per-minute price.
planNotes: Standard: $0/month, 10 agents, 10K sessions/month, for low traffic.
Advanced: $1,100/month, 100 agents, 300K sessions/month, professional services available at extra cost.
Fully Managed: custom, built and managed by Vonage experts.
NLU and Knowledge AI (generative) each $0.00855 per request on the snapshot read.
Voice, ASR and premium TTS are charged at regular Vonage API rates.
Fair usage: average of 50 events per session maximum.
Service packs start at $3,300 per month (Advanced/Managed context).
pricing.freeTrial: Standard plan is listed at $0/month with a 'Try it free' button.
whatIsExtra: Vonage Voice API minutes, ASR and premium TTS

strengths.claim: Free Standard plan lets teams build and self-deploy low-traffic agents before paying.
Multi-channel: one platform covers voice, SMS, WhatsApp and web chat.
Low-code drag-and-drop canvas of conversation nodes per Vonage's docs.
Pricing table lists Import/Export of flows, templates, insights and custom code at no additional charge.
Backed by Vonage's carrier-grade communications APIs and managed professional-services options.

limitations.claim: Regular Vonage API charges apply separately for voice, ASR and premium TTS, so the total per call depends on several line items.
Fair-usage limit of an average 50 events per session; beyond it Vonage may request an upgrade to Advanced.
Transcripts are retained for 90 days and telephony recordings for 30 days per the terms.

compliance.note: No compliance certifications stated on the pricing page or the docs overview read. Vonage has a Security & Trust page that was not read.

telephony.providedNumbers: Voice runs on Vonage Voice API; number options not described on the pages read.

stepsToLeave: The pricing page's feature table lists 'Import / Export Flows' as a platform feature; export format and scope were not verified.

bestFor: Teams already on Vonage APIs, or needing multi-channel low-code virtual agents with a free entry plan.
